e.title: ReSurv
e.summary: R 理赔次数 ML 预测包（CRAN）：ReSurv 模型——索赔次数的可解释机器学习
e.body: ReSurv（R CRAN，edhofman）是理赔次数预测的机器学习 R 包：ReSurv 模型（多任务生存分析的集成方法）用于预测索赔次数，比传统 GLM 更灵活且有学术论文背书。对 RIAA：理赔频率建模的 ML 进阶——传统 Poisson/负二项（[[tweedie-python]] 谱系）之外的现代方法；与 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价）、[[insurancerating]]（R 定价）配套做频率-严重度定价；配合 [[casdatasets]]（真实数据）直接跑实验；学术出版背书（European Actuarial Journal 论文）的课程项目选材。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：CRAN + GitHub 确认（ReSurv 理赔次数 ML 模型包，学术出版背书），未实测
e.summary_en: R ML package for predicting claim counts (CRAN): the ReSurv model — interpretable machine learning for claim frequency
e.summary_hk: R 理賠次數 ML 預測包（CRAN）：ReSurv 模型——索賠次數的可解釋機器學習
e.body_en: ReSurv (R CRAN, edhofman) is an R package for predicting claim counts with machine learning: the ReSurv model (an ensemble method from multi-task survival analysis) predicts claim counts more flexibly than traditional GLMs, backed by academic publications. For RIAA: an ML upgrade for claims-frequency modelling — a modern alternative to the traditional Poisson/negative-binomial lineage ([[tweedie-python]]); with [[machine-learning-pricing]] (ML pricing) and [[insurancerating]] (R pricing) it supports frequency-severity pricing; paired with [[casdatasets]] (real data) it runs experiments directly; academic-publication-backed (European Actuarial Journal paper) material for course projects.
e.body_hk: ReSurv（R CRAN，edhofman）是理賠次數預測的機器學習 R 包：ReSurv 模型（多任務生存分析的集成方法）用於預測索賠次數，比傳統 GLM 更靈活且有學術論文背書。對 RIAA：理賠頻率建模的 ML 進階——傳統 Poisson/負二項（[[tweedie-python]] 譜系）之外的現代方法；與 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定價）、[[insurancerating]]（R 定價）配套做頻率-嚴重度定價；配合 [[casdatasets]]（真實數據）直接跑實驗；學術出版背書（European Actuarial Journal 論文）的課程項目選材。
